flex_rules.rule: No more than 6 m of flex in any duct run.
Fully stretched, with no joints in a run: at 90% extension a flex loses about 3 times as much, at 70% about 10 times.
A bend's centreline radius at least 1 duct diameter; Temperzone asks 1.5.
Straight at least 300 mm out of a plenum, junction or boot before any bend.
A flex run's friction taken at twice its measured length.

takeoff_rules.rule: Never a duct smaller than the unit's spigot.
The outlets' total area at least the spigot's.
A run over 3 m stepped up one size.
Straight at least 300 mm out of the plenum before a bend.
A zone damper at least 0.9 m from the plenum and 1.8 m from any outlet.
Balanced at the takeoffs, not the outlets: less noise and less static.
